# Legacy setup renderer baseline

Captured from untouched production renderers at
`bdaf2c3235e45722d49cb07e47fca8c7d9d7fd0e`, before any setup/image edits.
The offline `setup_environment` boundary supplies deterministic release wheels,
Docker responses and repository declarations. Each provider uses `model`,
linux/amd64, port 8123, `/usr/bin/python3`, and no-start. There are no renderer
clock inputs. Deployment paths are not present in generated bytes.

`files.json` records every generated regular file's text and permission bits,
plus actual workspace/Cultivate and PyPI/core Dockerfile renderings. Credentials
are constructed from runtime fragments and replaced with `<runtime-secret>`
before persistence; no usable credential is recorded. The legacy manifest
omits `worklink_toolchain`. Tests compare these captured expectations without
regenerating them.
